'''Jom Vanten''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Exarch]] of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. He commanded the [[Hoth Star Fortress|Star Fortress]] above [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] until [[3631 BBY]], when [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance|Anti-Zakuul Alliance]] boarded the [[Star Fortress]] and killed him, overloading the [[Sun Generator]] and destroying the entire battlestation in process.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jom Vanten appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as the final boss of the Hoth Star Fortress.
